name: Revenue
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[revenue] )

name: Service Expenses
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[service_expenses] )

name: Net Reinsurance
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[reinsurance_net] )

name: Pool Surplus
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[pool_surplus] )

name: Service Result
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[service_result] )

name: Other Operating Expenses
expr: SUM ( fact_insurer_period[other_operating_expenses] )

name: Medical Revenue
expr: CALCULATE ( [Revenue], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "medical" )

name: Medical Loss Ratio
expr:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( [Service Expenses], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "medical" ),
    [Medical Revenue]
)

name: Medical Net Service Ratio
expr:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( [Service Expenses] - [Net Reinsurance] - [Pool Surplus], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "medical" ),
    [Medical Revenue]
)

name: Medical Service Margin
expr:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( [Service Result], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "medical" ),
    [Medical Revenue]
)

name: Total Combined Ratio
expr:
VAR rev = CALCULATE ( [Revenue], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" )
VAR opex = CALCULATE ( [Other Operating Expenses], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" )
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( opex ),
        BLANK (),
        DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Service Expenses], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" ) + opex, rev )
    )

name: Total Loss Ratio
expr:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( [Service Expenses], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" ),
    CALCULATE ( [Revenue], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" )
)

name: Medical Share of Revenue
expr: DIVIDE ( [Medical Revenue], CALCULATE ( [Revenue], fact_insurer_period[segment] = "total" ) )

name: Medical LR Prior Year
expr:
VAR py = MAX ( dim_period[prior_year_key] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE ( [Medical Loss Ratio], REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_period ), dim_period[period_key] = py )

name: Medical LR YoY (pp)
expr:
VAR cur = [Medical Loss Ratio]
VAR py = [Medical LR Prior Year]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( cur ) || ISBLANK ( py ), BLANK (), ( cur - py ) * 100 )

name: Medical LR Prior Quarter
expr:
VAR pq = MAX ( dim_period[prior_period_key] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( pq ), BLANK (),
        CALCULATE ( [Medical Loss Ratio], REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_period ), dim_period[period_key] = pq ) )

name: Medical LR QoQ (pp)
expr:
VAR cur = [Medical Loss Ratio]
VAR pq = [Medical LR Prior Quarter]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( cur ) || ISBLANK ( pq ), BLANK (), ( cur - pq ) * 100 )

name: Medical LR Rank
expr:
IF (
    ISBLANK ( [Medical Loss Ratio] ),
    BLANK (),
    RANKX ( ALLSELECTED ( dim_insurer[insurer_name] ), [Medical Loss Ratio], , ASC, DENSE )
)

name: Peers In Period
expr: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( dim_insurer[insurer_name] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Medical Loss Ratio] ) ) )

name: Rank Label
expr: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Medical LR Rank] ), BLANK (), [Medical LR Rank] & " of " & [Peers In Period] )

name: Medical Revenue Share of Peers
expr: DIVIDE ( [Medical Revenue], CALCULATE ( [Medical Revenue], ALLSELECTED ( dim_insurer ) ) )

name: Derived Note
expr:
IF (
    CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( fact_insurer_period ), fact_insurer_period[is_derived] = TRUE () ) > 0,
    "Q4 derived as FY minus 9M",
    BLANK ()
)
